MODULE_NOTES: Every tooltip in the Ordaen style: items, abilities, effects, players, NPCs and objects.
TOOLTIPS_ITEMSON_TIP: Off: item tooltips stay the game's own.
TOOLTIPS_SPELLSON_TIP: Off: ability tooltips stay the game's own.
TOOLTIPS_AURASON_TIP: Off: buff and debuff tooltips stay the game's own.
TOOLTIPS_OBJECTSON_TIP: Off: tooltips of signs, chests and gathering nodes stay the game's own.
TOOLTIPS_PLAYERSON_TIP: Off: player tooltips stay the game's own.
TOOLTIPS_NPCSON_TIP: Off: NPC and creature tooltips stay the game's own.
TOOLTIPS_ITEMSILVL_TIP: The first row of the stats.
TOOLTIPS_ANCHORTOBUTTONS_TIP: A button's tooltip shows above the button (action bars, the micro menu) instead of in the corner. Only where it shows, never what it says.
TOOLTIPS_ITEMSANCHORBAGS_TIP: For items in the bags and the bank. In the corner: bottom right. Beside the item: at its slot.
TOOLTIPS_ITEMSANCHORCHAR_TIP: For equipped items in the character window. In the corner: bottom right. Beside the item: at its slot.
TOOLTIPS_ITEMSCOUNT_TIP: In the bags and in the bank.
TOOLTIPS_ITEMSCOOLDOWN_TIP: How long until it can be used again.
TOOLTIPS_SPELLSCOOLDOWN_TIP: How long until it can be cast again.
TOOLTIPS_AURASCASTER_TIP: The name in its class colour; «You» for yours.
TOOLTIPS_PLAYERSRELATION_TIP: Your group or raid, your friends, your ignore list.
TOOLTIPS_NPCSLOOT_TIP: The name grey when the loot isn't yours.
TERM_DMG_TEXT: Weapon damage per hit, from least to most. Attack power adds to it.
TERM_FIRE_TEXT: Damage by fire: the target's fire resistance reduces it, not armour.
TERM_NATURE_TEXT: Damage by nature: the target's nature resistance reduces it, not armour.
TERM_FROST_TEXT: Damage by frost: the target's frost resistance reduces it, not armour.
TERM_SHADOW_TEXT: Damage by shadow: the target's shadow resistance reduces it, not armour.
TERM_ARCANE_TEXT: Damage by arcane magic: the target's arcane resistance reduces it, not armour.
TERM_HOLY_TEXT: Damage by holy magic: armour and resistances hardly reduce it.
TERM_SPD_TEXT: Seconds between swings. The smaller the number, the more often you hit.
TERM_DPS_TEXT: Damage per second: a hit's average damage divided by the speed. The way to compare weapons.
TERM_BAG_TEXT: A bag with %s slots: how many items it holds.
TERM_BOP_TEXT: Yours as soon as you pick it up. It can't be traded or auctioned.
TERM_BOE_TEXT: Can be traded or sold until you equip it. Then it's yours only.
TERM_UNI_TEXT: You can have only one of these.
TERM_BOUND_TEXT: Already yours: it can't be traded or auctioned, only sold to a vendor.
TERM_REQ_TEXT: The character level from which you can equip or use it.
TERM_PROF_TEXT: At least this profession skill: you can't learn the recipe or use the item before.
TERM_STACK_TEXT: How many of these fit in one slot.
TERM_OWN_TEXT: All of these in your bags and bank (the bank as you last saw it).
TERM_READY_TEXT: The time left until you can use it again.
TERM_CLS_TEXT: Only these classes can use the item.
TERM_DUR_TEXT: Drops when you die or take hits. At zero the item stops working: have it repaired.
TERM_LVLCOLOR_TEXT: The colour says how much stronger it is: |cff9d9d9dgrey|r gives no experience, |cff40c040green|r weaker, |cffffff00yellow|r even, |cffff8040orange|r stronger, |cffff2020red|r far stronger; «??» 10 or more levels above.
TERM_PVP_TEXT: PvP is on: players of the other faction can attack this character.
TERM_MANA_TEXT: The spell's mana cost. Mana comes back over time, faster out of combat and 5 sec. after your last spell.
TERM_ENERGY_TEXT: The ability's energy cost. Energy comes back quickly and steadily, up to 100.
TERM_RAGE_TEXT: The ability's rage cost. Rage builds in combat as you deal and take damage.
TERM_CASTTIME_TEXT: The seconds you stand still while it's cast. Damage taken can slow it.
TERM_CASTCHAN_TEXT: Lasts while you keep it up: move or get interrupted and it ends.
TERM_RANGE_TEXT: How far from the target you can use it.
TERM_CD_TEXT: How long to wait before using it again.
TERM_ELITE_TEXT: Much stronger than a usual creature of its level. Better fought in a group.
TERM_RARE_TEXT: Appears rarely; its loot is better than usual.
TERM_BEAST_TEXT: Some abilities work only on certain creature types.
TERM_TIME_TEXT: How much longer the effect lasts.
TERM_MAGIC_TEXT: A Magic effect: priests, shamans and some abilities can dispel it.
TERM_CURSE_TEXT: A Curse: mages and druids remove it.
TERM_POISON_TEXT: A Poison: druids, shamans, paladins and antidotes remove it.
TERM_DISEASE_TEXT: A Disease: priests, shamans and paladins remove it.
TERM_RANK_TEXT: The player's rank in their guild.
TERM_NPCDEAD_TEXT: This creature is dead: you can loot it, and skin some or gather herbs and ore from them.
TERM_STATUS_TEXT: The player sets «Away» and «Busy»; «Corpse» and «Ghost» while they're dead.
TERM_RELATION_TEXT: Your party or raid, your friends list (with its note) or ignore list.
TERM_CANCEL_TEXT: You can remove this effect yourself: right-click its icon.
TERM_MINE_TEXT: You (or your pet) put this effect on the target.
TERM_STACKS_TEXT: How many times the effect is applied: each stack makes it stronger.
